prompt_text: Where should I buy tires in Pleasanton CA and who does the best installation?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — a couple quick questions first so I can give the best local recommendations:
- What vehicle (make/model/year) and tire size (or current tire size from the sidewall)?
- Do you want new, all‑season, performance, touring, or all‑terrain tires?
- Any preference for price vs. brand vs. warranty? And do you have a Costco membership?

If you want general guidance right away, here are the common good options in/near Pleasanton and what they’re best for:

- Discount Tire (and America’s Tire locations)
  - Pros: large inventory, competitive prices, quick same‑day installs, good customer service and free rotation/balancing policies at many locations.
  - Good if you want fast service and lots of brand choices.

- Costco Tire Center (usually in nearby Livermore/Dublin)
  - Pros: very competitive pricing, excellent warranty and road‑hazard coverage, free lifetime rotations/balancing/flat repairs for members.
  - Cons: must be a Costco member, appointments can fill up and selection varies by location.
  - Good if you value price/warranty and have a membership.

- Firestone Complete Auto Care / Pep Boys
  - Pros: nationwide shops, can bundle installation with alignments and other services, warranties available.
  - Good if you want one‑stop service and dealership‑style warranties.

- Local independent tire shops (Pleasanton / Livermore area)
  - Pros: personalized service, sometimes better on small jobs or special tires (run‑flats, off‑road), owners often very responsive.
  - Good if you value local service and negotiating on price/installation.

How to pick the best installer
- Read recent Google & Yelp reviews about installation quality and wait times.
- Ask what’s included in the install price: mounting, balancing, valve stems, TPMS sensors/fees, disposal, alignment coupon?
- Confirm if they offer lifetime rotation/balancing, road‑hazard, and tire warranty handling.
- Check appointment availability and turnaround time if you need same‑day service.

If you tell me your car and tire needs I’ll:
- Suggest specific tire models (2–3 options at different price points)
- Find nearby shops in Pleasanton/Livermore/Dublin with addresses, phone numbers, and who’s best for installation based on reviews and service offerings.
